mapper.select: SELECT tracking_process_id, request_tracking_id, tracking_process_identifier, tracking_process_type, federated_twin_id, federated_digital_object_id, digital_twin_id, digital_object_id, tracking_command, tracking_kafka_group, tracking_kafka_topic, data_filter_type, event_occurred_count, event_condition, event_delay, event_end_date, tracking_status, create_time, tracking_status_change_time FROM tracking_process_info A WHERE NOT EXISTS( SELECT tracking_process_id, request_tracking_id FROM tracking_task_processing_info B WHERE B.tracking_process_id = A.tracking_process_id AND B.request_tracking_id = A.request_tracking_id) order by A.tracking_process_id desc

SELECT tracking_process_id, request_tracking_id, tracking_process_identifier, tracking_process_type, federated_twin_id, federated_digital_object_id, digital_twin_id, digital_object_id, tracking_command, tracking_kafka_group, tracking_kafka_topic, data_filter_type, event_occurred_count, event_condition, event_delay, event_end_date, tracking_status, create_time, tracking_status_change_time FROM tracking_process_info A WHERE 1=1 AND request_tracking_id = #{requestTrackingId}
